title: Weak encryption fallback defaults
description: INTERNAL_ENCRYPTION_SECRET defaults to 'default-dev-secret-do-not-use-in-prod' and SALT to 'payment-tracker-salt'. If env vars missing in production, AES-256-GCM keys are derived from known values.
impact: Any attacker with DB access can decrypt all encrypted fields.
fix: Remove default values and throw at startup if env vars are missing in production.

title: CSP nonce proxy not wired
description: The proxy() function implements per-request CSP nonces but is never exported as Next.js middleware.
impact: CSP falls back to 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline' weakening XSS protection.
fix: Create src/middleware.ts that re-exports proxy as middleware.

title: Auth bypass when Supabase is unconfigured
description: When Supabase env vars are missing, requireAuthenticatedUser() returns a fake user with ID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.
impact: Auth silently bypassed if env vars missing in non-production environments with real data access.
fix: Fail closed — return 503 in all environments.

title: Financial data in localStorage
description: All confirmed transactions persisted unencrypted in localStorage under key 'payment-tracker.transactions.v1'.
impact: Any JS XSS or physical device access leaks full transaction history.
fix: Encrypt before writing to localStorage or use IndexedDB with encryption.

title: Missing RLS INSERT policy on ai_logs
description: ai_logs table only has SELECT policy, INSERT operations will be blocked by RLS.
impact: AI audit logging is non-functional, missing audit trail.
fix: Add INSERT policy matching auth.uid() = user_id.

title: Rate limiter is in-memory only
description: Rate limit state lives in a Map on a single process — ineffective in serverless environments.
impact: API endpoints can be flooded across multiple serverless instances.
fix: Use Redis, Vercel KV, or database-backed rate limiting.

title: No CSRF token
description: Same-origin check is the only CSRF protection.
impact: Potential CSRF if an attacker controls a subdomain or exploits misconfigured CORS.
fix: Add CSRF token via double-submit cookie pattern.

title: Storage path reveals user UUIDs
description: Storage RLS uses storage.foldername(name)[1] — file path structure reveals user UUIDs.
impact: User UUIDs enumerable if storage URL pattern discovered.
fix: Use hashed user ID for folder names.

title: No XSS sanitization in Zod schemas
description: Zod validates types but doesn't strip HTML from title, note, merchantName fields.
impact: Low — React DOM escapes by default. Potential risk if data rendered server-side.
fix: Add transform() to strip HTML tags.

title: authHeaders() silently returns empty
description: When getBrowserSupabaseClient() returns null, authHeaders() returns {} allowing unauthenticated API calls.
impact: Invisible unauthenticated state could slip into production.
fix: Handle missing auth explicitly on client side.
